jobDescription:
Job Title: Sustainability Engineer

Experience: 3-5 Years

Location: Halol Location]

Job Summary:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced professional with an engineering background and a strong foundation in sustainability, with a particular focus on waste management strategies, water management and reporting, greenhouse gas (GHG) reporting (Scope 1, 2 & 3), and energy utilization. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in sustainability frameworks and compliance requirements.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and implement waste management strategies to minimize environmental impact.

  • Oversee water management and reporting, ensuring compliance with regulatory and sustainability standards.

  • Conduct GHG emissions reporting, covering Scope 1, 2, and 3, and support emissions reduction initiatives.

  • Analyze energy utilization and recommend energy-efficient solutions.

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to drive sustainability projects.

  • Stay updated on emerging trends, frameworks, and regulatory changes related to sustainability.

  • Provide technical support for integrating sustainability principles into operational processes.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering (Any discipline).

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in sustainability, with expertise in waste and water management, GHG reporting, and energy utilization.

  • Strong understanding of sustainability standards and frameworks.

  • Experience in data collection, analysis, and documentation related to sustainability performance.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Certifications in sustainability, waste management, energy management, or related areas are a plus.

  • Prior experience working with regulatory bodies or industry associations on sustainability matters.

  • Hands-on experience with sustainability data management tools and software.

title: P1
jobDescription:
JOB DESCRIPTION

SECTION I: BASIC INFORMATION ON THE ROLE

Role Name / Designation

Market Sales Representative (MSR) – On Roll

Function / Department

Marketing

Current Band/Level

AM/DM

SECTION II: JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for Influencer management in his area. This includes driving new influencer onboarding and engagement, influencer level billing targets, driving premium/new products and tertiary sales, market working as per plan with regular touchpoints with tagged Influencers and retailers and providing timely market feedback to BDM

Business development

§ Identify, convert and engage new influencers as per targets

§ Provide timely feedback to BDM regarding market feedback around loyalty program, products etc.

§ Use marketing collaterals to demonstrate current and new product portfolio attributes with influencers / key retailers

Influencer management and expansion

§ Own Influencer engagement and targets for the area and ensure 100% adherence to plan

§ Ensure market working as per plan - influencer identification, verification, segmentation and enrollment. Influencer engagement as per defined frequency to drive tertiary revenue, understand need gaps and market best practices

§ Lead site visits for contractors in the area and drive conversions and engagement

§ Conduct regular electrician meets and contractor meets as per plan – discuss product portfolio, feedback/complaints around products or loyalty program, demonstrate product attributes, info. around influencer loyalty program, distribute gifts/product samples/brochures etc

§ Nurture and develop strong professional relationships with tagged influencers and key retailers – ensure consistent billings on app

§ Engage with key retailers to identify new influencers, push premium/new products, showcase on-ground product demonstrability and increase tertiary billings on retailer loyalty program. Also responsible for ensuring POSM material display, sharing marketing collaterals/brochures etc.

Process initiatives

§ Complete trainings as per the defined training calendar

§ 100% adherence to KPI monitoring process



SECTION III: KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Measurable deliverables

§ Number of new influencers onboarded

§ Number of active influencers scanning on the system

§ % Tertiary sales captured on Loyalty program app

§ Premium portfolio contribution

§ Influencermeets as per plan / target

§ Campaigns/Initiatives/project(s) as per plan/target

SECTION IV: JOB REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications

Graduation is must (Engineering background preferred), Prior experience as LAS/Promoter/Distributor salesman etc

Skills & Functional Competencies

§ Goal oriented: Proven history of sales record, sets clear priorities & meets targets

§ Result oriented: entrepreneurial and self-motivating, good planning and organizational ability

§ Excellent sales and negotiation skills, and high commercial and business awareness

§ High level of communication ability and presentation skills, energized and enthusiastic, ability to build strong relations with key customers

§ Natural leader: Positive, driven, has ability to influence, sets good examples, ambitious and flexible

§ Self-starters, resilient, resourceful, and able to perform under pressure

§ High market presence & regular interaction with all stakeholders, should know the geography well

Specific Experience

§ Total experience in the range 2-3 years with relevant experience of 1+ year as a LAS/Promoter/Distributor salesman etc in retail market

Overall experience

1+ years of total experience
